main_text.p: [ijuunio ... ] ... vt eos ... rim funt, vt pars ad Hunnos Scythasque confugerent; alii Danubium ...

tacte vecti, interquentes Francos ... Avarum bello à Pipino ... Carolus ... cia falcepste. ... Tassilonem ... Tassiloni Rex, ut fecit, & le iusque Carolo tradidit. Calarus ... exstructo ad Mosquam ... ponte, Danubium Rheno comminuere ... vit; perfecitque ... Pipin ... Illum Principatu ... lo imbribus, aliisque ... opus ... iussit ... bus sunt animo ... ut ...

Primâ, praemisso ... Rheno ... Carolus ... tionem ... quo Carolus Pater barbara & antiquissima carmina ... tur, literis ... iuxta Teutonicam ... & ventos duodecim ... fa, quod Wiltsaous ... Caroli ... cum ... conceptum ... filio, ... bimque ... fereanno ... quo Pannoniae ... mutatione incolatum ... ut

page.notes: The scan is faint and heavily show-through affected; much of the text is illegible or only partly readable. Lines are transcribed as far as legible, with gaps marked by ellipses in the text where I could not read words with confidence; these ellipses are for my own reference and should be replaced with [illegible] markers where unreadable. Marginal year numbers (795, 793, 794, 795, 798) are visible at left. Right-margin notes are too faint to read.
